en.headline: Three private cars collide on Cheung Tsing Highway; nobody hurt
en.dek: The three vehicles piled up near the airport spur on Saturday night and stopped in the fast lane; all three male drivers passed breath tests, police said.
body: Three private cars collided on Cheung Tsing Highway towards the New Territories at about 9.55pm on Saturday near the slip road towards the airport, forming a three-vehicle pile-up, according to local reports corroborated across several outlets.
The cars came to a stop in the fast lane. One vehicle’s rear was badly dented. None of the three male drivers was injured. Officers who attended the scene said all three passed a breath test.
Traffic on the highway was congested for a time while police examined the scene. Investigators are looking into how the collision started. No arrests were reported.

zh.headline: 長青公路三私家車串燒相撞 無人受傷
zh.dek: 三車周六晚近十時在往新界方向近機場支路相撞後停在快線，三名男司機通過酒精呼氣測試，警方正調查起因。
body: 周六晚上約9時55分，三輛私家車沿青衣長青公路往新界方向行駛，至近往機場支路附近相撞，形成串燒，其後停在快線上。
現場可見其中一輛車尾嚴重凹陷。三名男司機沒有受傷，到場警員為他們進行酒精呼氣測試，結果全部通過。
意外一度造成該處交通擁塞。警方正調查意外起因，暫未有人被捕。
